snippet.title: Spirit Ritual - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Spirit Ritual is a supernatural horror VR/MR game. Become a psychic medium and break the demonic curse threatening the life of Shu-Mei Lin. Equip your camera, enter the spirit realm and capture ghosts to reveal the truth. Fail, and the demon will consume your soul.
